description_en: Retrieves the interval-based statistical report for a specified agent in a specified instance
description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定坐席的分段统计报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-interval-agent-skill-group-report --agent-id agent@ccc-test --start-time 1532448000000 --end-time 1558443508000 --instance-id ccc-test --interval Daily --skill-group-id skg-default@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIntervalAgentSkillGroupReport

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp. The default value is 00:00 on the current day. The statistics are measured in hours and rounded down to the nearest hour. This is a closed interval
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳，默认为当天的0时。统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is not required. The default value is the current time. If Interval is set to Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is set to Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. The statistics are measured in hours and rounded up to the nearest hour. This is an open interval. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned time range for the input parameters is \[11:00:00, 12:00:00), which means greater than or equal to 11:00 and less than 12:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00)，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of interval-based statistics. This parameter is not required. The default value is Daily (summarized by day)
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，非必填，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval
